description: Bind an external ID (e.g. feishu_user_id:d8c6g9xx) to a xuanchu user. For Feishu users, prefer provider feishu_user_id with the user's user_id so identities stay consistent across apps. Admin/owner can bind for others; regular users can only bind to themselves.

external_id.description: external ID value. For Feishu users, pass the user's Feishu user_id (not open_id/union_id) for cross-app identity consistency

provider.description: external ID provider. For Feishu users, prefer feishu_user_id

name: user_bind
